description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This is an excellent opportunity for a Registered Nurse (RN) to step into a pivotal leadership role, contributing to the delivery of high-quality patient care and supporting our nursing team.

As ADON, you will play a crucial role in assisting the Director of Nursing with the overall management of nursing services, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards, and fostering a positive and efficient work environment. We offer a competitive annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, reflecting your expertise and commitment to our residents.
requirements: Previous experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care facility
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking skills
Knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.

description: We are seeking an experienced and dedicated Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Olathe, KS. This pivotal leadership role offers a competitive annual salary ranging from $85,000 to $110,000, reflecting your expertise and commitment to excellence in patient care.As the DON, you will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of clinical care, and fostering a supportive and professional environment for our residents and staff. You will play a crucial role in maintaining regulatory compliance, managing nursing personnel, and implementing best practices to enhance resident outcomes. This is an urgent opportunity for a passionate leader ready to make a significant impact.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Kansas
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience as a Director of Nursing or in a similar nursing leadership role
Prior experience in a Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
Demonstrated ability to lead, mentor, and manage a diverse nursing team
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $110,000, compensation based on experience.

description:

This urgent opening offers a competitive salary and the chance to contribute significantly to a facility committed to excellence in patient outcomes and staff development.

Proven experience as a Director of Nursing or in a similar nursing leadership role within a skilled nursing facility
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations
Demonstrated ability to lead, manage, and develop nursing staff
Commitment to a permanent, full-time position
